answer: Reputation escrow with quadratic correlated slashing breaks coordinated farms. Each grader posts standing as collateral; when a panel grade later diverges from the settled consensus, every member is slashed quadratically. A sybil ring moving in lockstep suffers far deeper loss than an independent mistaken grader. The beacon of honest divergence stays protected, while an echo of identical votes erodes capital faster than linear, like a karst cave collapsing under repeated drips. Attackers must split votes and lose coordination, or pay penalties exceeding what a cloned cluster can steal.
